text:
incident-bot: PAGING: svc-embeddings-eu p95 latency > 2.5s for 3m, auto-escalation to oncall (maria). bridge: https://redwood/bridge/2834567890

maria (oncall): ack, joining bridge now. starting mitigation steps.

maria (oncall): rolled routing fallback to eu-1 -> eu-2, switching requests to quantized-embed-v2 to reduce tail.

jordan (sre): seeing KV cache thrash + backlog on the routing layer right before spike. CPU on eu-1 hosts went 85-95%.

lee (eng-runtime): confirmed routing table churn from a scheduled config push that partially failed, left stale sticky routes to overloaded hosts. working on durable route eviction change.

maria (oncall): containment update: latency down to p95 ~1.1s after fallback, p99 still ~2.2s. holding the bridge for 20m while we stabilise.

tia (support): support tally: ~47 affected customers in EU, 3 of them reported degraded embeddings causing search scoring to be off. sent initial comms to enterprise contacts.

maria (oncall): quick customer note drafted — @tia please send the confirm when stable, include mitigation steps and ETA for postmortem.

tia (support): will send once we have final numbers and RCA note.

ops-manager: thanks team. next: we need a post-incident review, concrete action items, and alert tuning so this doesn't page on transient churn.

maria (oncall): proposing postmortem Wed 2026-03-25 15:00 PT. draft agenda: timeline, RCA, mitigation timeline, action owners, paging rules update, SLO review.

jordan (sre): action item: add short-term throttle to routing config to avoid full failover during partial pushes. owner: jordan. due: 2026-03-18.

lee (eng-runtime): action item: open PR for route-eviction logic + feature flag for rolling config pushes. owner: lee. due: 2026-03-22.

ops-manager: action item: review SLOs for embeddings in EU (p95 vs p99) and propose paging thresholds to reduce noise. owner: ops-manager. due: 2026-03-20.

maria (oncall): suggested alert rule rewrite (proof-of-concept):
```yaml
alert: HighLatency_EmbeddingsEU
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, job)) > 3
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "p99 embeddings > 3s in eu"
```

jordan (sre): +1 to p99-based paging for embeddings; also add a suppression window for deploy-related churn: don't page if deploy.label exists for < 10m.

devops-bot: deploy detected: config-push-2026-03-17T09:12Z (eu). marking alerts with deploy.label=config-push-2026-03-17T09:12Z while in rollout.

lee (eng-runtime): will add a short-circuit to route updates to ensure partial failures don't leave sticky routes. PR link (when ready): https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/xxxx

maria (oncall): scheduling: postmortem Wed 2026-03-25 15:00 PT. invite list: SRE, Eng-runtime, Support, Product, DevEx. please add any other stakeholders. action tracker: https://issues.redwood/INC-2834567890-actions

ops-manager: propose two monitoring follow-ups: 1) convert embeddings alert to p99 for paging, 2) create a noisy-alert suppression policy (deploy and canary windows).

jordan (sre): I'll draft the alert diffs in the alert repo and add unit tests for suppression rules.

maria (oncall): summary of owners/dates in thread: jordan - routing throttle (2026-03-18); lee - route eviction PR (2026-03-22); ops-manager - SLO/proposal (2026-03-20); tia - customer comms (ASAP once stable).

tia (support): sending final customer update now.

maria (oncall): thanks all. closing bridge in 10. leaving this thread for postmortem scheduling and action tracking. :thumbsup:
